title: Energetic characterisation of transient clustering dynamics in aggregation-diffusion systems
summary: We investigate transient clustering dynamics in nonlocal aggregation-diffusion systems from an energetic perspective. Starting from a stochastic interacting particle system, we study the associated macroscopic McKean-Vlasov equation on the torus and exploit its Wasserstein gradient-flow structure to analyse the thermodynamic competition between interaction-driven aggregation and entropy-driven diffusion.
